question: Who is the customer on the first one?
reason: The customer (Blackstone Beach Resort) is right, but the answer card shows 'Referenced records: Invoice #3033'. 3033 is the database id of invoice E6071. GPT-6 Luna's t4 plan selected only invoice.customer_id and invoice.customer_name, so with_record_hrefs fell back to '<resource label> #<record_id>' (app/rag/provenance/record_links.py:191-194). In Wave I the same turn's plan also selected invoice.invoice_number and the label was 'E6071'. The model change exposed a fallback that was always there.
